items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: he used to play in most all these bands... he'd sit down and work with us lots of times

ctx.x: Well they had a fellow Yard, forget that boy named him now, he used to play in most all these bands, that alto. Even him was Oscar. Oscar something. Oscar Devone, Oscar Devone, Oscar Devone, some kind of Oscar or nothing. But he could play that like that alto because he'd sit down and work with us lots of times. It helped out a whole lot. Like I said, we'd let you rest. Yeah. Did he play melody?
